source.title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
source.authors: Chao Wan, Paul Junger, Beixi Du, Bodong Liu, Navaneetha Krishnan, Kilian Q. Weinberger (Cornell + ASAPP)
source.source_level: A (arXiv abs+HTML全文98K curl本地解析,一手可读,无订阅墙)
source.open_source: NO_OFFICIAL_CODE_REPO; 附录G开放权重judge(open-weight≠开源代码),CC BY 4.0; GitHub三组检索全0,不编造源码

kernel_mirror: 论文'能力不对称'(检索器漏掉证据生成器捞不回)+共享上下文可比性(候选放一起打分才可比,单独看着相关的在更好候选面前P(Yes)被压低)+CRITICAL召回上限≠首位命中(dense top100含gold 98.4%但导航首位命中70.1%>61.9%)+不可逆剪枝(pruned branches never expanded)
side_effects: none — 不写盘、不消费、不进判定、不改被扫字段

checks: recognition.four_classes_jointly: 四类判定(USER/ARCHIVE/DECLARED/NOISE)必须在同一次probe返回里并列可比,单独各判都通过却未并列即SEPARATE_NOT_COMPARABLE
recognition.flag_and_noise: recognition_flag=ALL_RECOGNIZED 且 UNRECOGNIZED_NOISE=0 在统一判定口径下成立
birth.synced_and_authentic_dual: synced_rate(召回/coverage=0.9091)必须与authentic_birth_rate(首位真就位=0.1818)双列,只报召回不报首位即RECALL_MASKS_TOP1
birth.backfill_exposed: backfilled_sync_count=8 / authentic=2 / total=11 显式暴露'召回含8条背填,真就位仅2'
archive.class_disclosed: 归档账14条gap_entries的class分布(ACCEPTED_BOUNDARY/HISTORICAL_IMMUTABLE/RESOLVED_EXECUTED)显式带'不再追/不动/已恢复'处置,裸标NOISE无处置即PRUNED_IRREVERSIBLE
archive.budget_and_recovery: decision字段显式给出剪枝预算与可恢复路径(13条不再追/9条不动/1条RESOLVED),不静默丢弃

classification.force_class_injection: 注入方显式force_class覆盖仅供负向测试,生产恒None
